spoken_summary: A Fox News report details accusations against Graham Platner, a Democratic candidate for the Maine Senate backed by Elizabeth Warren. He is reportedly under fire for old, deleted Reddit posts in which he mocked a wounded U.S. soldier and Purple Heart recipient. One post allegedly stated, "the soldier didn't deserve to live." The report notes that Platner has acknowledged making remarks under the Reddit username "P. Hustle."

central_claim: Democratic Maine Senate candidate Graham Platner is unfit for office because he cruelly mocked a wounded Purple Heart recipient online, stating the soldier "didn't deserve to live."
intended_effect: To generate disgust and outrage toward Graham Platner and the Democratic party for supporting him.
